thesis: AMPH is a clean uptrend backed by a real earnings inflection. Q3 net income more than doubled YoY and revenue growth has accelerated for three quarters. Price sits above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200, all stacked upward, with strong relative strength, and it has held 29-30 since the 11/06 post-earnings spike. Valuation is low in absolute terms and the business is a defensive-leaning pharma name, which fits a regime where defensives lead. The setup is only moderate: the entry must be a dip into the 28.70-29.50 zone, not a chase, and the trade needs a clean break of the 31.00 high to reach the target. Regime is risk-off, so this is a conditional, small-conviction long.
